proposals.evidence: Proposed full reduplication of alag ‘different/separate’, with CDIAL 700 alagna supporting the base family. Repetition is an analysis of the survey form, not a separately reconstructed ancient compound. The alag anchor is from Sonipura-Balai, while these repeated forms occur at other survey sites; it represents the proposed survey-level base, not evidence that one village borrowed from another. Acceptance depends on Nimadi proposal 176; local vowel length and the precise distributive nuance remain qualified.
